title: Chicken, Blueberry and Walnut Salad
excerpt: Enjoy a colorful, crunchy chicken, blueberry and walnut salad, perfect for a fresh, light lunch full of homemade flavor.
imageAlt: Fresh salad in a deep bowl with golden chicken pieces, walnuts and plenty of whole blueberries.

ingredients.text: 2 cooked chicken breasts, shredded or cubed
4 cups chopped Batavia or mixed lettuce
A pinch of salt and pepper, to taste

steps: Wash the lettuce very well and disinfect it, then cut it into medium pieces and place it in a large salad bowl as the base.
Spread the cubes or pieces of cooked chicken evenly over the bed of lettuce.
Add the chopped walnuts to give the dish a crunchy touch.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the high mountains of Guasca, for their characteristic natural sweetness and vibrant color.
In a small bowl, mix the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper until you get an even dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad right before serving and toss gently to bring all the flavors together.
tips: To keep the freshness and natural bloom of the blueberries, store them in the fridge unwashed and in their original packaging until you are ready to use them.
You can lightly toast the walnuts in a skillet over low heat for a couple of minutes to intensify their aroma before adding them to the salad.
